lead.zh: 从「AI 能不能进课堂」到「怎么用它备课、出题、批改和互动」。每一步都留一个教师复核点，避免把模型输出直接交给学生。
lead.en: From “can AI enter the classroom” to lesson prep, question generation, grading and interaction. Every step keeps a teacher checkpoint so model output never goes straight to students.

steps: 怎么用 AI 出题与批改
怎么设计课堂 AI 互动

zh: 说清 AI 生成的内容在课堂上哪些可以直接用、哪些必须教师先核
用一条学习目标写出「导入—讲解—练习—总结」四段活动，并标出 AI 参与点
给学生一条 AI 可能出错的题目，让他们找出错误并说明理由
课堂 AI 互动，为什么要先设「不许问」的边界？
用 AI 出题，如何避免题目只考记忆？
学生用 AI 写作业，评价应改成看什么？
备课资料含学生数据，最小化处理是什么？
AI 批改的分数，什么时候必须人工复核？
把 AI 内容带进课堂，标识与版权怎么讲？
一节课的 AI 使用，怎么写进学习目标？
en: Explain which AI-generated classroom content can be used directly and which a teacher must verify first
Turn one learning objective into hook, explanation, practice and summary, marking where AI participates
Give students an AI-generated question that may be wrong and have them find and explain the error
Why set “do not ask” boundaries before AI interaction in class?
How do you avoid AI-generated questions that only test recall?
If students use AI for homework, what should assessment look like?
Lesson material contains student data; what is the minimum handling?
When must an AI-graded score be reviewed by a human?
How do you teach labelling and copyright when bringing AI content into class?
How do you write AI use into a lesson’s learning objectives?

answers.zh: 事实、公式、日期、例题答案和涉及价值的判断必须教师核；活动创意、分层练习和表达变体可以先由 AI 起草。
answers.en: Facts, formulas, dates, worked answers and values judgments need teacher verification; activity ideas, tiered practice and wording variants can be drafted by AI.

answers.zh: 学习目标写「学生能做什么」；四段各标时间、师生活动和检查点；AI 参与点要写清是生成、追问还是反馈。
answers.en: Write the objective as “what students can do”; each phase gets time, teacher/student actions and a checkpoint; state whether AI generates, probes or gives feedback.

answers.zh: 重点不是「AI 也会错」，而是学生能指出错在条件、计算还是结论，并用教材或原文反驳。
answers.en: The point is not “AI can be wrong” but that students can locate whether the condition, calculation or conclusion failed, and rebut it with the textbook or source.
answers.review: 怎么设计课堂 AI 互动

answers.zh: 先明确哪些问题不该交给外部工具（学生隐私、考试题、未公开资料），再谈怎么用。没有边界，互动会先泄露数据，再谈学习效果。
answers.en: Define what must not go to an external tool (student privacy, exam items, unpublished material) before discussing use. Without boundaries, interaction leaks data before learning effects matter.
answers.review: 怎么设计课堂 AI 互动

answers.zh: 要求题目给新材料、让学生解释理由、比较两种方案或找出错误；答案要能按 rubric 判，而不是只对知识点。生成后自己先做一遍，删掉歧义题。
answers.en: Ask for new material, explanations, comparisons or error-finding; answers must be rubric-scorable, not just recall. Solve them yourself and delete ambiguous items.
answers.review: 怎么用 AI 出题与批改

answers.zh: 看过程证据：提纲、修改记录、来源核对与口头解释；再看最终作品。只评成品无法区分谁写的，也无法教方法。
answers.en: Look at process evidence: outlines, revision history, source checks and oral explanation, then the final work. Product-only grading cannot distinguish authorship or teach method.

answers.zh: 去掉姓名与可识别组合，只保留教学需要的字段；外部工具只用脱敏样本，并确认留存与删除。不要把原始班级表直接上传。
answers.en: Remove names and identifying combinations, keep only fields needed for teaching, use masked samples in external tools and confirm retention/deletion. Do not upload the raw class roster.

answers.zh: 涉及升学/奖惩、主观题、边界分数、疑似抄袭或学生申诉时。机器分只能当初筛，最终分数要有可解释的 rubric 与复核人。
answers.en: When it affects progression, rewards, subjective items, borderline scores, suspected plagiarism or appeals. Machine scores are a first pass; final scores need an explainable rubric and reviewer.
answers.review: 怎么用 AI 出题与批改

answers.zh: 讲清哪些内容必须标 AI 生成、哪些素材不能直接商用、引用要回到原页。让学生用一张「来源/许可/标识」三列表检查自己的作品。
answers.en: Teach which content must be labelled AI-generated, which assets cannot be used commercially, and that citations must return to the original. Have students check their work with a source/licence/label table.

answers.zh: 写成可观察的行为：学生能用 AI 生成初稿、核对两条来源、指出一处错误并说明理由。不要写「会用 AI」这种无法验收的目标。
answers.en: Write observable behaviour: students draft with AI, verify two sources, identify one error and explain why. Avoid unassessable goals such as “can use AI”.
